title: 電光ブレイクス
caption: Mid-1980s electro-funk and hip hop instrumental with a Japanese city pop flavour. A hard drum machine breakbeat with a booming kick, handclaps and cowbell, a squelchy analog synth bass line, bright city pop chord stabs on a digital electric piano, rhythmic vinyl record scratching as the lead, arcade game bleeps, a soaring analog synthesizer solo. Energetic, futuristic, an electric town of neon signs and game arcades. Instrumental, no vocals.
